summary.intent: Update the codebase map documents (primarily CONCERNS.md) to reflect work completed in phases 28-33, then clean up stale references discovered during the review.
summary.outcome: CONCERNS.md and STRUCTURE.md were updated on a dedicated docs branch, a PR was created (FSM1/cipher-box#390), legacy POC concern removed, stale Docker host IP reference removed from STRUCTURE.md, and 192.168.133.114 sanitized from all planning docs.

repo: Phase 28 replaced all console.log/warn/error calls with a structured logger at apps/web/src/lib/logger.ts, but web3auth/hooks.ts retains 12 unguarded console.time/timeEnd calls
Phase 30 added Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) and Prometheus metrics (apps/api/src/metrics/), but registerFaroTransport() is defined and never called — logger errors don't reach Faro

Phase 31 decomposed useSharedNavigation.ts (1199→378 lines) and FileBrowser.tsx (964→362 lines); folder.service.ts (1059 lines) and bin.service.ts (971 lines) remain large but are now considered cohesive
Phase 32 resolved the macOS FUSE FilePointer blocking concern; Phase 33 completed the Windows equivalent using rt.spawn() channel patterns in crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/read_ops.rs
The legacy POC directory was removed in commit ee9bcd4e4 during Phase 28 — it no longer exists in the working tree
FUSE production code has 19+ mutex lock().unwrap() call sites that can cause cascading panics on mutex poisoning
IPNS unenrollment is fire-and-forget with no persistence across tab closure

workflow: When updating codebase maps after a git pull collision, stash doc changes, reset to origin/main, then restore — avoids a merge commit in the planning docs branch
Running the concerns mapper twice (before and after Phase 33 merge) produced a more accurate result; worthwhile to pull latest before running analysis
Committing planning doc updates to a dedicated docs/ branch keeps them out of feature branch history and makes PR review easier
Scanning planning docs for sensitive values (IPs, tokens) as part of the map-codebase workflow caught a dev IP that had propagated to 15 planning files

friction: git pull failed due to divergent branches after the initial commit — required manual stash/reset/restore dance to get onto latest main before re-running the concerns mapper
